entities.name: MurE ligase candidate
observations: 499-aa query has 49.8% identity and 96.8% coverage to reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate–2,6-diaminopimelate ligase (UniProt Q59650).
Homology supports a cytosolic, Mg2+-dependent ATP ligase adding meso-diaminopimelate to the peptidoglycan precursor UMAG; reference enzyme EC 6.3.2.13, Rhea RHEA:23676.
Calculated sequence properties: molecular mass ~52.36 kDa; theoretical pI 5.25. These are sequence-derived estimates, not experimental measurements.
